name: portfolio
description: Root script contract (spec 001, REQ-REPO-002). Scripts only: no dependencies, no workspaces, no lockfile.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:web && npm run format:check:api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.audit: npm run audit:web && npm run audit:api
scripts.verify: npm run check:repo && npm run test:hooks && npm run test:scripts && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:web && npm run audit
